```python
"""Reports CSV exporter."""

_QUOTE_CHARS = (',', '"', '\r', '\n')


def _escape(field):
    if any(c in field for c in _QUOTE_CHARS):
        return '"' + field.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return field


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Export mappings in column order as RFC 4180 CSV, including the header."""
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for name in cols:
        if not isinstance(name, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if name in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % name)
        seen.add(name)

    lines = [_escape(name) for name in cols]
    out = [",".join(lines) + "\r\n"]
    for row in rows:
        fields = []
        for name in cols:
            value = row.get(name, "")
            if value is None:
                value = ""
            fields.append(_escape(str(value)))
        out.append(",".join(fields) + "\r\n")
    return "".join(out)
```
